results.inspector: GrassEye Map Plugin Package Governance Inspector

findings.message: Orchestration runtime context must consume the governed active map registry.
Commander task template registry must source ordinary task templates separately from developer bindings.
Task start flow must resolve approved launch bindings through the governed active registry before mission dispatch.
Task start binding must source approved launch records from the governed active registry.
Task start launch binding must resolve task-template launches through the active registry instead of trusting raw ordinary-mode bindings.
Map package inspector baseline must pass before negative-proof mutations can run.

phases.name: owner-foundation
phases.summary: Manifest and generated matrix align for the standalone non-phase-gated map package inspector.

phases.name: required-shape
phases.summary: Map package schema, quarantine lifecycle, builtin payloads, and registry bootstrap are present.

phases.name: forbidden-shape
phases.summary: Map package builtins remain declarative JSON and the package layer has no executable escape surfaces.

phases.name: boundary-attack
phases.summary: Orchestration or Commander still preserves a legacy static path that bypasses governed map packages.

phases.name: anti-escape
phases.summary: Map package enforcement closes through a real inspector, full audit support files, and a direct runner entry.

phases.name: scorecard-gate
phases.summary: Map package scorecard remains explicit, provisional, and aligned with the governed closeout gate.

phases.name: required-shape
phases.summary: Map-plugin integration required schema, registry, task-template, or proof shape is incomplete.

phases.name: forbidden-shape
phases.summary: Forbidden reverse-schema imports, platform fallback paths, ordinary mapBinding surfaces, and legacy static maps are gone.

phases.name: boundary-attack
phases.summary: One or more map-plugin to Orchestration or Commander boundaries still route through the wrong seam.

phases.name: negative-proof-harness
phases.summary: Map package negative-proof harness cannot start because the baseline inspector is not passing.

results.summary: Orchestration or Commander still preserves a legacy static path that bypasses governed map packages.
